description: Books a free 30-minute Agent Strategy Call with Novaeon in a free slot, on behalf of a person. The slot is reserved at once; the person gets a confirmation email with a calendar file and Novaeon sends the meeting link. Rate limited.

company.description: Company and role of the person (write "private" or "freelancer" if that applies)

consent.description: Must be true: the person agrees Novaeon stores these details to arrange the call (https://novaeon.studio/privacy).

email.description: Email address for the confirmation and the meeting link

language.description: Language of the confirmation email (default en)

message.description: What they want to discuss: task or problem, systems involved, goal. At least 50 characters.

start.description: Start of a free slot (ISO 8601, UTC)

name: book_call
title: Book the Agent Strategy Call
